In this issue

  • Content Is a Revenue Driver Now. Content is now a revenue driver in ecommerce.
  • What a Real Content Layer Looks Like. So what's the alternative? A headless CMS separates content from presentation.
  • Why This Matters for Commerce. The first thing that changes is speed. When your content team can publish without filing a dev ticket, output goes up.
  • The Pricing Reality. Here's where it gets interesting. Most merchants hear "headless CMS" and assume enterprise pricing.
  • Who Should Care. Not every merchant needs a headless CMS. If you publish one blog post a month and your Shopify blog handles it fine, keep going.
  • The Composable Commerce Connection. This fits into a larger shift happening in ecommerce architecture.
